entry.title: Les Éclaireurs Lighthouse

terrainReference.basis: Standard PMTiles zero datum; bounded reconstructed rock footing.

entry.note: The inspected picture supports the red/white/red tapered tower, low door, open black gallery/lantern and bounded rock under its base. Retained mapped node supplies location. Heading0 is an explicitly approximate south-facing doorway and north-facing panels, not a measured bearing. Standard viewer PMTiles are zero at this very small islet and do not resolve its rock. Browser tiers therefore include a bounded roughly10m rock footing rising1.1m above that datum and retain the11m tower height. This is an approximate visual footing, not the complete island or a surveyed tide/focal-height datum. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
